newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Latam ADRs follow U.S. stocks lower.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Latam ADRs follow U.S. stocks lower.

text.p: Latin American telecommunications companies saw their American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) follow U.S. stocks lower in early morning trade, despite having released good earnings reports, dealers said Friday.
"They are down this morning in sympathy with the Dow Jones," said one dealer, referring to the industrial index.
Brazil's telephone holding company Telebras SA was down 4-5/8 at 143-3/4, while Peru's Telefonica del Peru was 1-3/16 lower at 23-1/2.

The Dow industrials were down 86 points or about one percent to 8144 in morning trading following the release of the July National Association of Purchasing Managers Index data, which showed a rise in the prices paid component.
One trader said he suspected profit taking was pushing the Telebras ADR lower.
"There's nothing wrong with Brazil or Telebras," he said, adding that the ADR was trading amid relatively low volume.

Early on Friday, Telebras released earnings, showing a rise in its consolidated net income for the first six months of the year to 5.70 reais per 1,000 shares from 5.07 for the same period a year ago.
On Thursday, the Peruvian telephone company reported second-quarter earnings of 0.103 soles per share, against 0.075 for the same quarter a year ago.
European ADRs appeared to wrench away from the downward pull, some of them with the help of encouraging quarterly earnings, another dealer said.
Anglo-Dutch foods and consumer products group Unilever Plc was 3-1/16 higher at 121 after it reported second-quarter earnings that beat analysts' best expectations.
Italian apparel and footware company Fila Holdings SpA was 13/16 higher at 33-1/2 a day after reporting weak second quarter earnings due to fewer U.S. sales.

France's Alcatel Alsthom was 1/2 higher at 27-1/2, Akzo Nobel NV was up three at 80-7/8, Swedish-American drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn was up 1/16 at 37-13/16 and Israeli drugs company Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd up 1-11/16 at 57-3/4.
Decliners led advancers 347 to 154 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group was down 0.74 percent, while volume at midday was 40.8 million ADRs.
ADRs allow U.S. trade of foreign shares.
